column2: which makes its way into the ftrace output

column1: and ends up crashing sleepgraph because it expects the ftrace output

of ""HID-SENSOR-INT-020b.39.auto"". It causes this crash in sleepgraph:
File ""/usr/bin/sleepgraph""

it has also exposed a larger bug in sleepgraph
make sleepgraph crash. Sleepgraph needs to be able to handle binary
